|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Tarkin (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee printing of this version ([[:File:V4-D-tarkin-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC printing (card image or errata sheet slip); card-image dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later), slip dates are the errata sheet's PDF date. Every visibly different printing is a separate version, and an errata sheet slip is a version of its own, separate from the card image of the same errata (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). '''Errata mark:''' the earliest image found already prints “E”: the PC had issued an errata of this card before its image repository began (8 July 2018), and no printing of the earlier text was found (searched: the PC errata sheets of 2019–2023, the Holotable image history including other file names, and the 2021 set sheets). Listed with the [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription errors]] (marks that do not match the version).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-tarkin022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/tarkin.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/tarkin.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: errata mark “E”; bottom margin “•Tarkin”. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may draw cards from Reserve Deck until you have up to six cards in hand. During battle, if present with two ISB agents, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Tarkin (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 1 June 2022<ref name="img-tarkine8445f0">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Dark/large/tarkin.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e8445f08fa931119eec2c3f95d5cea095145da26 commit e8445f0] (1 June 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual4-Dark/large/tarkin.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the errata mark “E” → “E1”; the bottom margin “•Tarkin” → “Tarkin” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: errata mark “E1”; bottom margin “Tarkin”. It is the current image. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When deployed, may draw cards from Reserve Deck until you have up to six cards in hand. During battle, if present with two ISB agents, may cancel an opponent's just drawn destiny.”
